summary: v1.0.25 review (Live Presence Phase 1 + Back-button rework + Account deletion + Privacy policy) verified LIVE on sandbox. Backend 4/4 PASS: privacy HTML has Marathi section, demo-account delete-request 409 demo_protected, worker /api/presence/my-status returns enabled/in_pilot/stop_after, demo CGM /api/presence/live returns counts/zones/workers with all expected count keys (tracking, in_zone, gps_inside, gps_outside, no_signal, not_tracked, stopped). WEBDASH Live Presence page (/api/dash/presence) as demo CGM +919123456789 PASS: nav-presence entry present, KPI strip renders 14/16 Tracking / 0 In zone / 0 Inside factory (GPS) / 0 Outside factory / 13 No signal / 2 Not tracked / 1 Tracking stopped, zones card lists 29 zones with search + hide-empty toggle, leaflet map renders with geofence dashed circle and 41 zone/worker markers, worker list has search/dept-filter/zone-filter/status-filter/outside-first controls, presence-updated ticker went 'updated 3s' -> 'updated 9s' confirming 15s auto-refresh cadence. Language switch EN->मरा PASS: title changes to 'लाइव्ह कर्मचारी उपस्थिती', zone names render in Marathi ('लेखा कार्यालय', 'प्रशासन कार्यालय', 'बॉयलर', 'सर्क्युलेटर रूम', 'डिस्टिलरी बॉयलर' etc.). MOBILE (390x844) as worker 0021 +917972540971 PASS: OTP login (via CDP Input.insertText) reached /home, presence-chip-off rendered with Marathi text 'ट्रॅकिंग बंद — पुन्हा सुरू करा' (worker had earlier stopped tracking — amber variant as spec). Shared header verified on /alerts, /id-card, /attendance/history, /profile (all show [data-testid=screen-header] + [data-testid=screen-header-back-button]). /presence-consent renders Marathi-first with consent-lang-mr/hi/en tabs + consent-agree-button + consent-later-button + 5 consent-point rows. /battery-help renders oem-xiaomi/vivo/oppo/realme/samsung cards + open-settings-button. /delete-account (non-demo worker) renders screen-header + delete-gone-card ('कायमचे डिलीट होईल') + delete-kept-card ('कायद्याने राहील') + delete-start-button — did NOT trigger deletion. testID naming mismatch flagged below. Deprecated packages: NONE observed. SafeAreaView issues: NONE. React Native red screen: NONE.

ui_bugs.issue: Request expected testIDs 'profile-privacy-link' and 'profile-delete-account'; actual testIDs in code are 'privacy-policy-link' (line 145) and 'delete-account-entry' (line 155). Rows ARE rendered (verified in source /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx) but were below fold in my screenshot — testID mismatch only. Suggest normalising to the requested names OR updating the review request.

Request expected testIDs 'delete-account-deleted-forever' and 'delete-account-kept-by-law'; actual testIDs are 'delete-gone-card' and 'delete-kept-card'. Content is correct (Marathi 'कायमचे डिलीट होईल' + 'कायद्याने राहील'). testID naming mismatch only.

One-off: screen-header not detected after 3.5s wait during automation, but /app/frontend/app/shift.tsx:92-93 renders <ScreenHeader ... /> unconditionally inside SafeAreaView. Suspect data-fetch race delaying hydration in the sandbox (other 4 screens PASS with identical pattern). Not reproducible from the code path. Main agent should self-verify with a longer wait or by simply loading /shift in an authenticated browser.

issues: Yellow 'Switched OFF for real users: Config-driven home screens — Turn on: Admin → Feature flags' banner still shows above the presence page on 1440x900 — cosmetic, main agent already noted a similar quirk on 360px. Does not block the presence UI.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning at app boot: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Only a Reanimated/RN 0.76+ deprecation notice, not blocking. Reference: emitted from Home screen at load; grep for 'shadowColor|shadowOffset|shadowOpacity|shadowRadius' across /app/frontend/src and /app/frontend/app and migrate to the new boxShadow style prop.

/app/webdash/src/screens/Presence.tsx — 15s poll + updated-ticker + counts-derivation matches the spec; testIDs cover the whole surface (kpi-*, zone-board, zone-search, hide-empty, presence-map, worker-list, worker-search, dept-filter, zone-filter, status-filter, outside-first, presence-updated, worker-row-*). Zone name locale swap works because names_i18n is keyed off i18n.language.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:143-161 — privacy + delete rows are properly conditionally rendered with the correct routing + Linking; testIDs differ from review-request nomenclature (see ui_bugs).

/app/frontend/app/delete-account.tsx — 'delete-gone-card'/'delete-kept-card'/'delete-start-button' testIDs are present, warning content is trilingual, and the destructive action is one extra tap away (no accidental delete).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile OTP login recipe (worked): (1) goto /, wait 4.5s, click page.get_by_text('मराठी', exact=True) or English lang, (2) on /phone screen fill [data-testid=phone-input] with the 10-digit number (NO +91 prefix — country code chip is separate), click [data-testid=send-otp-button], (3) on /otp?phone=... screen click [data-testid=otp-boxes] then use CDP Input.insertText one char at a time for '123456' — page.fill/page.type do NOT work on the segmented boxes, (4) click [data-testid=verify-otp-button]. Home presence chip testID variants: presence-chip-off (amber, tracking stopped), plus green/red variants; scan [data-testid^=presence-chip-] to find the active one. Webdash OTP verify button testID is 'login-verify' (not login-verify-otp). Presence page KPI keys use underscore separators: kpi-in_zone, kpi-gps_inside, kpi-gps_outside, kpi-no_signal, kpi-not_tracked, kpi-stopped, kpi-tracking (tracking value column). Correct actual mobile testIDs (may differ from spec): profile page → privacy-policy-link + delete-account-entry; delete-account warning → delete-gone-card + delete-kept-card + delete-start-button. Direct /battery-help works unauth (public route) — OEMs are Xiaomi/Vivo/Oppo/Realme/Samsung with testIDs oem-<lowercase>.
